To get your Retell AI API key:

  1. Log in to your Retell AI dashboard.
  2. Open **Settings > API Keys**.
  3. Copy an existing key or create a new one.
  4. To use the webhook triggers, use the key marked with the **webhook** badge: Retell signs webhooks with that key only.

Retell sends call events to one account-level webhook URL. To use this trigger:

1. In the Retell AI dashboard, open **Settings > Webhooks**.
2. Set the account webhook URL to:
```text
{{webhookUrl}}
```
3. Save. Retell sends **call_started**, **call_ended** and **call_analyzed** to that URL; this trigger only reacts to **call_started**.
4. The connection must use the API key with the **webhook** badge (Settings > API Keys). Deliveries whose X-Retell-Signature does not match that key are ignored.

An agent with its own webhook URL sends its events there instead of to the account URL. Nothing is registered or removed automatically when this flow is turned on or off.
